economy.summary: Her priorities page commits to policies that make the community more affordable without tax increases, citing the cost of groceries, gas and energy prices, and healthcare, and calls for holding corporations accountable for price gouging.
economy.short: Supports affordability without tax increases; hold corporations accountable for price-gouging.

taxes.summary: In a primary voter guide she said affordability relief should come without tax increases and emphasized responsible use of tax dollars and making government work efficiently for residents.
taxes.short: Says relief should come without tax increases; efficient use of tax dollars.

abortion.summary: Her priorities page says it is vital to protect the fundamental right to access reproductive healthcare without interference, with decisions made between a woman and her doctor rather than politicians.
abortion.short: Supports protecting reproductive healthcare access; decisions between woman and doctor.

education.summary: Her priorities page supports fully funding public schools so classrooms have well-trained teachers, up-to-date materials, and safe facilities, and says educators deserve living wages.
education.short: Supports fully funding public schools; living wages for educators.

energy.summary: In a primary voter guide she said she supports House Bill 1834 to regulate data center growth, citing the need to protect the power grid and prevent energy cost increases for residents.
energy.short: Supports HB 1834 regulating data-center growth; prevent energy cost increases.

guns.summary: Her priorities page lists supporting violence prevention through strong local programs and resources; the site does not detail positions on gun policy.
guns.short: Supports local violence prevention programs; no stated gun policy.

economy.summary: His campaign site says he wants to keep everyday life affordable by focusing on taxes, utilities, housing, and responsible growth, and supports lower costs, better infrastructure, and reduced regulatory burden.
economy.short: Supports affordability via taxes, utilities, housing; reduced regulatory burden.

taxes.summary: His campaign site calls for responsible tax relief, less red tape for small businesses, transparent government, and responsible budgets.
taxes.short: Supports responsible tax relief, transparent government, responsible budgets.

abortion.summary: In a 2024 candidate survey he said health care decisions regarding abortion must remain between a woman and her doctor, particularly when fetal viability or maternal health is at risk, and said he would prioritize reducing the number of elective abortions through adoption services, improved prenatal healthcare, and family support programs.
abortion.short: Says abortion decisions belong with woman and doctor; reduce elective abortions.

education.summary: In a 2024 candidate survey he said he supports school choice, allowing parents to direct educational funds to public, private, or charter schools while ensuring public school funding remains intact, and backed increased investment in vocational and technical education.
education.short: Supports school choice keeping public funding intact; vocational education investment.

energy.summary: In a 2024 candidate survey he said he supports energy independence through modernized energy infrastructure to reduce utility costs for families and businesses.
energy.short: Supports energy independence through modernized infrastructure; lower utility costs.

guns.summary: His campaign site says he will support police, firefighters, and EMS with proper training, tools, and staffing, prioritizing safe neighborhoods; it does not detail positions on gun policy.
guns.short: Supports funding police, firefighters, EMS; no stated gun policy.
